w: 13 Dec. 99 to 16 Dec. 99 Maha Abhishek Ceremony of Murtis at Swaminarayan Mandir, Tithal, and 79th Birthday Celebration Festival at Valsad.
December 99: (Kartak Vad 9, V.S. 2056), Wednesday, Kailashpuri

After performing the murti pratishtha ceremony at the Shree Swaminarayan Mandir, Swamishri addressed the devotees in a huge assembly: "… Many intelligent people say that where is the need for mandirs? Why don't you build schools, colleges and hospitals. The answer is we do build schools, colleges and hospitals and perform various social services. Yes, we do need to stay with society and the country (and offer our services to it) but alongwith this it is also important that people should be inspired with moral and spiritual values. And if there is no character then there will be conflict and unrest between man and man. If we want to bring Satyuga in Kaliyuga then one has to abide by God's laws. Through Satsang one is inspired with moral and spiritual values and with peace in life… Through such holy places our society will improve and get better…"
We have been blessed with the infinite favors of God and for that when we build a mandir it benefits our society, our country, and redeems our soul.
Dharma bestows goodness and happiness in life.
It is because of our dehbhav (profound attachment to physical self) that we cannot establish Satsang as it is in our soul.

The world is not still and unwavering and one's mind is also not still and unwavering. Then how can one attain peace and happiness by merely talking about it? it is God who gives stillness to the world and mind.
This morning, Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha for the murtis of the mandir at Bhandut. This was the 400th murti pratishtha ceremony performed by Swamishri.
The evening assembly was celebrated as 'Bal Din' in which the commitment and sacrifice of Bal Karyakars was justly appreciated.

w: In the evening satsang assembly, BAPS youths performed a traditional dance. The BAPS Youth Forum enacted a drama, 'Kaf', which showed the pride of devotees who have internalized satsang in their lives. Thereafter Swamishri addressed the assembly, "Be he a sadhu or a householder, if one is proud of satsang then the devotee experiences happiness and pride in his life. When one realizes the glory of God's form then one loses all love for worldly things. He performs his worldly duties but God and His realized Sadhu are primary in his life ..."

A devotee came for Swamishri’s darshan. Formerly he was doing a lot of satsang and came regularly to the mandir. But due to bad company he got hooked to drinking liquor and thus stopped doing satsang. Swamishri asked him, “Why are you not coming here?” “A lot of my time goes into doing business. There’s no time left for satsang,” the devotee offered an excuse. Swamishri countered, “So many in the world run businesses an still attend satsang regularly. If they can take time out then why can’t you? When your relatives arrive don’t you have to take time out for them? Similarly, you have to do it for God. Come once in a day for darshan to the mandir. Make all efforts to earn, but you also have to do something for your soul.” “He has become habituated to drinking liquor,” someone revealed. “Yes, that’s why you have stopped coming to the mandir. Instead of stopping to come to the mandir, you should stop drinking!” Swamishri inspired him with care and love to do satsang.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

The wife of Khanna Saheb, the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi, had passed away. Atmaswarup Swami gave this news to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, so Swamishri had a call placed to him.
Swamishri said to him, "Jai Swaminarayan. I am Pramukh Swami speaking."
Khanna Saheb said, "My salutations at your feet."

Swamishri said, "Atmaswarup Swami phoned. He gave the news that your wife has passed away; her life span must have been complete, and that is why this has happened. My blessings are that you and the family may find peace."
Khanna Saheb said, "Your grace on us is great. We bow our heads to God's will and God's pleasure."
Swamishri said, "If there is this understanding, it is a very good thing."
Khanna Saheb said, "I want to tell you that at the time of her passing I saw light on her face. Great was God's grace that he took her with him."
Swamishri said, "At the time of death, God showed the light and God took her to his abode."

For the last four days or so, Pramukh Swami Maharaj had been concerned about the worldly affairs of a devotee. A devotee's daughter is studying in London. Talks were going on for her marriage with a satsangi youth, but in practical terms the elders on the girl's side felt the need for some clarification. For two days they had been in contact with Swamishri about this. In this very context Swamishri had phoned Yogvivek Swami, the kothari of London, two or three times and obtained his opinion about the youth. Two days earlier that same youth came here for Swamishri's darshan, and the attendant sadhu pointed him out to Swamishri, saying, "This is the youth with whom talks are going on for that devotee's daughter." Seeing him, Swamishri said, "After I finish my meal, connect me with him by phone." In this way Swamishri spoke with this youth by phone for about seven minutes, and when Swamishri was satisfied, he spoke again with the devotee and gave his consent to proceed with the marriage, but along with that also told him to come here and meet this youth.

Today they came here with their family members. As Swamishri had guided, they had sat down with this youth. Now everyone was agreed, so they wanted to speak with Swamishri. However, keeping Swamishri's health in mind, for the last several days the doctors had especially requested him not to give individual meetings. Accordingly, individual meetings were not possible. Everyone was sitting on the terrace outside Swamishri's residence. Dharmacharan Swami said to Swamishri, "Everyone on the girl's side has sat down with the youth; now they are all sitting outside. Please speak on the phone and give your blessings."
Swamishri said, "Have them all stand here at the door, and let them meet me individually one by one."
Dharmacharan Swami said, "For that I will have to ask. Please give your blessings on the phone."
Although Swamishri insisted, he gave them blessings on the phone.

After a while Narayancharan Swami came. Swamishri told him the same thing again and insisted on meeting those devotees. Of course, it was not possible. After a while Swamishri said, "Has Yogicharan come?" Yogicharan Swami, who looks after Swamishri's health, took a little while to come. When he came, Swamishri told him too, "What dedication and sacrifice all these people have!" Keeping his health in mind, Yogicharan Swami said a few things, but Swamishri became a little restless, so, understanding Swamishri's wish, everyone agreed.

Jabreshwar Maharaj was brought outside. Materials for the ritual and prasad were placed on a seat. It was about 11.15. The door of the bedroom had been opened, and Swamishri stood there. On Swamishri's behalf, Abhayswarup Swami gave the sanctified coconut to both sides, and in this way Swamishri himself had the ritual performed. Then, still standing at the door, Swamishri said, "You have my blessings. Both of you like each other and both of you now want to go ahead, so now no other problem should arise. This is a bond for ever. Whether joy or sorrow comes, stay together, and let there be no hurt feelings at all, and if there are, remember God. By God's grace, make compromises, and you will live in peace."

In his presence and with his own enthusiasm, Swamishri had this ritual performed and joined the relationship. In particular, standing in the doorway, Swamishri said that if there are ever hurt feelings between husband and wife, they should remember God. Swamishri's boundless compassion had showered on this family today, so the meaning of Swamishri's blessings was that they should remember this divine, compassionate form.

Today Pramukh Swami Maharaj's walk was starting again. From around the 30th, keeping his health in mind, his walk had been stopped. Today this walking was to begin under the supervision of Dr Ashwinbhai Mehta, but as Ashwinbhai was not quite well, he could not be present; still, Swamishri was taken for a walk today. First there was a five minute walk and then, after a rest, about seven minutes. Relatively, everything was satisfactory from the point of view of health. Everyone welcomed this occasion with joy.
When it was time to go and rest, Brahmvihari Swami said, "We'll meet tomorrow."
Swamishri said, "Why tomorrow?"
Brahmvihari Swami said, "Tomorrow is a good day, isn't it!" (He said this with reference to Swamishri's birthday.)
Swamishri said, "For us all twenty four hours are good. We have met God and met the Sant, we have had their darshan, so all days are good."
Brahmvihari Swami said, "Then please stay pleased."
Swamishri said, "Am I to be pleased only today? Not tomorrow? Not the day after? Not always? Pleasure is to be kept always, twenty four hours."
Swamishri said a wonderful thing.
